features.feature: Embedded browser creation, routing, URL policy, and CLI open aliases
gaps: zmux only accepts browser open PANE_ID URL and navigate|goto SURFACE_ID URL
No open-split/new aliases, workspace/window routing, focus flag, profile selector, caller-workspace default, typed surface refs, external-open policy, or browser availability override
Zmux accepts HTTP(S) and about:blank, rejects credentials and other schemes, and has no configurable allow/external policy
acceptance: Create and navigate through one shared action from menu, CLI, shortcuts, palette, popup, and restore paths
Support cmux open/open-split/new routing and errors without focus theft
Preserve atomic URL rejection and distinguish invalid URL, missing target, browser-disabled, and capacity failures

features.feature: Browser chrome navigation, reload, hard reload, stop, and address focus
gaps: Basic back/forward/reload-stop, address focus, find, and zoom exist
No hard reload/cache semantics, CLI back/forward/reload, snapshot-after, shared action dispatcher, or configurable shortcuts
Reload menu always calls reload even while toolbar uses stop
acceptance: Menu, toolbar, shortcut, palette, and CLI use the same focused-or-explicit browser action
Disabled states track navigation and load state
Hard reload and stop have explicit observable outcomes and errors

features.feature: Omnibar URL/search resolution, suggestions, link routing, and external-open policy
gaps: Zmux prefixes host-like input with https but has no search-engine query resolution or suggestions
No custom search template, embedded-host rules, external URL list, terminal-open interception, link-hover URL, insecure-host prompts, or copy-link failure recovery
acceptance: Resolve URL versus search input with the selected engine and custom template
Apply host and external-routing rules consistently to omnibar, page links, terminal links, and open commands
Expose hover and insecure HTTP decisions without leaking credentials

features.feature: Browser tabs, popups, moves, close/reopen, and placement
gaps: Windowless WebKit navigation opens a sibling browser tab and browser close/reopen preserves only observed URL/title
No browser tab list/switch/close/new CLI family, browser popup window policy, move to new workspace, back-forward restoration, profile restoration, or popup/dialog ownership
Generic tab drag payload is terminal-named and cross-pane/window browser behavior is unverified
acceptance: Popups, target=_blank, context actions, CLI tab commands, and undo-close use stable browser descriptors
Preserve profile, supported history, tab order, placement, and focus
Failed restore remains retryable and cannot duplicate a live surface

features.feature: Browser lifecycle, hidden-memory budget, process termination, and page restoration
gaps: Hidden WKWebViews are retained and a native smoke checks form state across tab switches
Process termination only shows text; no recovery overlay/action, discarded-page state, bounded memory policy, timer/budget modes, form-state restoration, media-aware discard, or preload pool
No lifecycle soak or measured resource budget
acceptance: Bound hidden browser memory and discard according to configured budget/timer without losing the wrong tab
Recover process termination and discarded pages with stale-generation protection
Verify hidden tabs, media, forms, downloads, inspector, close, and memory pressure in native soak tests

features.feature: Persistent browser profiles and data isolation
gaps: Zmux uses a separate nonpersistent WKWebsiteDataStore per tab, so isolation exists only for one live tab
Missing default and named persistent profiles, list/create(add/new)/rename/clear/delete(remove/rm) aliases, selectors by name/slug/UUID, destructive confirmation, and open/restore profile binding
acceptance: Profiles isolate cookies/storage and persist across launches
Implement list, create, rename, clear --all|--force, and delete with stable selectors and explicit errors
A surface never silently changes profile during restore or popup creation

features.feature: Browser data import workflow
gaps: No browser import UI or CLI

Missing interactive and agent-safe noninteractive cookies-only flow, source browser/profile selection, all-profiles, destination profile creation, domain filters, history/additional-data warnings, and ten-minute timeout semantics
acceptance: Import supported browser cookies into an explicit profile with preview, warnings, progress, cancellation, and no credential logging
Support documented aliases and reject obsolete positional data types
Report imported/skipped counts and unsupported source data

features.feature: Downloads UI, save policy, history, list, and wait
gaps: Zmux explicitly cancels download navigations and unknown MIME responses

Missing ask-where-to-save policy, safe filename/path handling, PDF preview handoff, toolbar/popover progress, failure state, bounded per-surface history, stable download_id, list --limit 1...25, and wait path/timeout
acceptance: Download through WKDownload with bounded progress/history and safe destinations
List is repeatable and surface-scoped; wait consumes only its event contract
Cancellation, overwrite, missing path, process exit, and failed download remain visible

features.feature: Dialogs, web permissions, HTTP auth, client certificates, SSL trust, and insecure HTTP
gaps: No JavaScript alert/confirm/prompt owner or CLI accept/dismiss
No camera/microphone/geolocation/notification permission UX, HTTP Basic retry, client-certificate picker, scoped SSL trust bypass, insecure HTTP allowlist/prompt, or authentication challenge errors
Public WKWebView APIs cover dialogs, media capture and authentication challenges, but per-tab geolocation spoofing does not
acceptance: Present page-owned dialogs and respond through UI and CLI without blocking socket/main actors
Scope trust and credentials to the correct host/profile and never persist secrets accidentally
Permission denial, cancellation, unavailable capability, and stale dialog are distinct

features.feature: Cookies, local/session storage, and browser state save/load
gaps: No cookie get/set/clear filters or storage local/session get/set/clear
No state save/load file contract, origin scoping, path sandbox, atomic write, versioning, or profile compatibility checks
Per-tab nonpersistent store disappears at close
acceptance: Implement cookie name/value/url/domain/path/expires/secure/httpOnly/all semantics with scope-required clear
Operate local/session storage against the active origin and selected frame policy
Save/load versioned browser state without exposing cookies in normal output

features.feature: Automation snapshot, eval, get, and predicate operations
gaps: Missing snapshot interactive/cursor/compact/max-depth/selector, eval script, get url/title/text/html/value/attr/count/box/styles, and is visible/enabled/checked
No element-ref allocation/lifecycle or stale-ref errors
No bounded output or structured JavaScript error contract
acceptance: Resolve explicit browser surface, document/frame, CSS selector or generated element ref
Return typed JSON and stable text output with bounded sizes
Distinguish not found, ambiguous, stale ref, JavaScript error, page recovery, and timeout

features.feature: Semantic locator families
gaps: Missing find role --name --exact; text/label/placeholder/alt/title/testid --exact; first/last --selector; nth --index --selector
No accessibility-name normalization or element-ref return
acceptance: Implement all locator leaves and exact semantics against the active frame
Return reusable refs scoped to document generation
Reject cross-origin iframe control explicitly

features.feature: Pointer, form, selection, highlight, and scroll automation
gaps: Missing click/dblclick/hover/focus/check/uncheck/scroll-into-view, type/fill, select, scroll dx/dy/selector, highlight, and snapshot-after
No event trust/focus policy or post-action recovery
acceptance: Route every operation through the resolved browser context with optional post-action snapshot
Honor disabled/read-only/form control behavior and native focus
Return explicit selector and action errors without silent DOM-only success

features.feature: Keyboard automation and wait conditions
gaps: Missing press|key, keydown, keyup, named W3C/Playwright keys, and snapshot-after
Missing wait selector/text/url/load-state/function with millisecond/second timeouts
No native replay guard, document readiness wait, stale recovery, or socket timeout headroom
acceptance: Deliver supported keys through native WebKit event replay and never downgrade trusted input silently
Waits run off the main actor and terminate on condition, timeout, navigation supersession, close, or cancellation
CLI timeout and handler deadline stay consistent

features.feature: File input selection and browser pane file drop
gaps: Missing set-input-files --selector with repeatable --file or --clear and snapshot-after
Missing 128-file/32-MiB limits, directory rejection, access lifetime, remote transfer distinction, native file-drop routing, and upload failure UI
acceptance: Select only regular readable files within count/byte limits and release security scopes
Drop/picker/CLI converge on one upload action
Remote browser/file sources use explicit transfer rather than local path assumptions

features.feature: Browser screenshots
gaps: Zmux native smoke captures one WKWebView snapshot only
No user/CLI screenshot action, output path, JSON result, temporary-file lifecycle, viewport-aware dimensions, animation-frame readiness, DOM crop, pasteboard writer, or failure contract
acceptance: Capture the explicit surface without focus mutation
Write atomically to --out or return a bounded temporary artifact and omit redundant base64
Verify exact dimensions under viewport emulation and page zoom

features.feature: Frame selection and JavaScript dialog automation
gaps: Missing frame main/select and dialog accept [text]/dismiss
Cross-origin control must return not_supported rather than imply parity
No pending-dialog state, owner surface, close cancellation, or stale-dialog error
acceptance: Frame context is surface and document-generation scoped
Main-frame reset always works; cross-origin limitation is explicit
Only the current pending dialog can be answered and prompt text is supported

features.feature: Developer tools, JavaScript console, console entries, and page errors
gaps: Missing devtools toggle/dev-tools alias and console window
Missing console list/clear and errors list/clear with bounded capture
No attached/detached inspector lifecycle, focus handoff, viewport conflict handling, or WebKit log/error normalization
acceptance: Open/close inspector without losing browser or terminal focus
Capture bounded console and error records per surface and clear deterministically
Inspector conflicts with viewport and process recovery are explicit

features.feature: Focus mode, design mode, and React Grab
gaps: Missing react-grab/reactgrab toggle with --return-to, focus-mode enter/exit/toggle/on/off, and design-mode enable/disable/toggle/status
Missing token capture/artifact handoff, UI toolbar/popover, Escape policy, browser-disabled errors, and focus return
acceptance: UI, shortcut, palette, and CLI modes share one surface-scoped controller
React Grab validates return surface before capture and reports artifact delivery
Mode state clears safely on close, navigation, page recovery, and app focus change

features.feature: Page zoom and exact viewport emulation
gaps: Zmux supports UI zoom 0.5...3.0 and reset

No numeric CLI zoom, explicit surface/workspace routing, configured default zoom, exact 1...4096 CSS-pixel viewport, reset, aspect-fit, render-limit details, inspector/fullscreen rejection, or screenshot integration
acceptance: Persist and apply default page zoom while allowing per-tab changes
Viewport emulation preserves pane geometry and returns structured render limits
Inspector attach/redock and fullscreen transitions reset or reject predictably

features.feature: Browser REPL, MCP bridge, init scripts, scripts, styles, and stateful sessions
gaps: Missing repl eval/interactive/guide/list/reset/mcp, --session, --eval, --timeout, --workspace, --max-output, stdin mode, and idle cleanup
Missing addinitscript/addscript/addstyle registration and reload behavior
No filesystem root sandbox or output spill artifact
acceptance: Provide isolated named/ephemeral REPL sessions with bounded output and explicit timeout
Reject overly broad filesystem roots and clean unnamed sessions
Scripts/styles are surface/profile scoped with count and removal lifecycle

features.feature: Automation leaves constrained by public WKWebView APIs
gaps: Leaves are geolocation|geo, offline, trace start/stop, network route/unroute/requests, screencast start/stop, input mouse/keyboard/touch, and input_mouse/input_keyboard/input_touch
At the cmux baseline these return typed not_supported for per-tab geolocation spoofing, offline emulation, Playwright trace, CDP request interception, CDP screencast, and raw CDP input
Parity requires the commands and honest errors; it does not require inventing unsafe private APIs
acceptance: Expose every leaf and return stable not_supported with capability-specific detail on WKWebView
Keep supported click/hover/scroll/press alternatives discoverable
Only claim implementation if a public-API replacement has equivalent observable behavior

features.feature: Remote and mobile browser surfaces
gaps: No remote/cloud browser resource, mobile stream/frame acknowledgement, viewport/dialog/input protocol, reconnect mask, or remote host execution proof
Local WKWebView browser does not establish remote browsing parity
acceptance: Keep local and remote browser identity explicit
Bound frame/input queues and recover stream loss without replaying stale input
Verify navigation and command execution occur on the intended host

features.feature: Markdown open, render, file links, live reload, and unavailable-file state
gaps: No markdown panel or CLI shorthand/open routing
Missing workspace/surface/window/direction/focus options, marked/GitHub-style rendering, safe local links/images, live file watching, atomic-save reload, and missing/unreadable file state
acceptance: Open an absolute resolved path in a real panel without allocating a PTY
Render documented Markdown structures and resolve file links safely
Coalesce file changes and show explicit unavailable/recovery state

features.feature: Markdown text editing, find, typography, zoom, copy, and persistence
gaps: Missing preview/text modes, dirty/save/conflict behavior, rendered find/next/previous, copy as Markdown/HTML, font size/family/max width, per-panel zoom, and default-following semantics
No keyboard action routing for markdownZoomIn/Out/Reset or shared find
acceptance: Edit/save without overwriting newer disk content silently
Find survives rerender and focus changes
Panel customization follows defaults until locally changed and can reset explicitly

features.feature: Diff viewer inputs, git sources, layouts, navigation, and trusted sidecar
gaps: No patch/stdin viewer; unstaged/staged/branch/last-turn sources; repo/base/session/title/focus/font-size; unified/split layout; file/hunk navigation; or trusted local sidecar
No diffViewer.defaultLayout persistence or empty/error states
acceptance: Render supplied patch and each git source without shell injection
Authorize only the selected repo/session files and expire sidecar trust
Support split/unified, file/hunk navigation, search, viewed state, and explicit empty/error states

features.feature: Diff review comments, viewed files, preferences, and submission handoff
gaps: No line/file comments, persistent per-repo review store, viewed toggles, saved-but-unsent pool, terminal TextBox handoff, consume/rollback, or review filters
No protection against one page using another repo's comments
acceptance: Persist comments and viewed state per canonical repo
Submit pending comments once through an explicit agent-input handoff and restore them on failure
Reject untrusted pages and malformed comment payloads

features.feature: File preview modes and live reload
gaps: No text, PDF, image, media, or Quick Look preview surfaces
Missing PDF thumbnails/outline/zoom/rotation/share/viewport restore, image zoom/anchor, media session, native drag, remote preview refresh, latest-request wins, and unsupported/oversize/error states
acceptance: Select preview mode from actual file type and size with explicit fallback
Reload only the newest request and preserve safe viewport state
Close cancels observation/media/loading and releases files

features.feature: Text file editor and viewer settings
gaps: Missing saveFilePreview, word wrap, syntax highlighting, line numbers, indent guides, current-line highlight, tab width, encoding/error/conflict handling, and zoom
No dirty close confirmation or atomic saver
acceptance: Save atomically with encoding preservation and conflict reporting
Apply all fileEditor settings live
Shortcut/menu/palette actions share save/wrap/find/zoom owners

features.feature: File explorer local/remote tree, search, mutations, open routing, drag, and path insertion
gaps: No right-sidebar file tree/search or local/remote provider

Missing create file/directory, rename, delete, duplicate/conflict policy, rg search and errors, external/default/preferred editor, open-in-cmux preview, terminal path insertion, multi-selection, drag ownership, and remote mutations
No fileExplorer.doubleClickAction setting
acceptance: Browse and mutate the exact local/remote root with generation-safe refresh
Search streams bounded results and reports rg absence/failure
Open/drop/insert paths are quoted or transferred according to target ownership

features.feature: Global search across browser, markdown, terminal, agent sessions, titles, and locations
gaps: No global search index/palette, snippets, bounded page/terminal capture, refresh lifecycle, inline browser/markdown/terminal find handoff, or menubar search
No commandPaletteSearchesAllSurfaces setting
acceptance: Index only bounded non-secret content from live known surfaces
Selecting a result activates the exact window/workspace/pane/surface and applies inline find
Deleted/stale targets cannot misroute

features.feature: cmux.json JSONC settings, schema validation, legacy fallback, live reload, and error reporting
gaps: Zmux only stores sidebarCollapsed in UserDefaults
No ~/.config/zmux JSONC schema, validation, atomic writes, legacy precedence, file watcher, config reload, pending terminal reload, supported-path listing, or path-specific errors
No equivalent of config validate/reload or reload-config
acceptance: Define an original MIT settings schema and ownership boundaries
Validate the complete document before atomic write and preserve unknown non-settings sections intentionally
Reload live with exact path/constraint errors and no app restart

features.feature: Settings window, searchable sections, and CLI target routing

Missing path/paths, docs/documentation, open [target], direct target aliases, and shortcuts launcher

Targets are account; app/general; themes/theme/appearance; terminal; sidebar/sidebar-appearance/sidebarappearance; custom-sidebars/customsidebars; automation; browser; networking/network/iroh; computers/devices; browser-import/browserimport/import-browser-data; global-hotkey/globalhotkey/hotkey; keyboard-shortcuts/keyboardshortcuts/shortcuts/keys/keybindings; workspace-colors/workspacecolors/colors; cmux-json/cmuxjson/settings-json/settingsjson/json/file/settings-file; reset
acceptance: Open Settings to every supported canonical target and alias
Settings search routes to a stable section/row
CLI path/docs operations work without a running app while open targets report connection errors

Missing customSearchEngineName, customSearchEngineURLTemplate, showSearchSuggestions, theme system|light|dark, defaultZoomLevel, discardHiddenWebViews, hiddenWebViewDiscardMode budget|timer, hiddenWebViewMemoryBudgetMB, hiddenWebViewDiscardDelaySeconds, autoRestoreUnloadedPages, askWhereToSaveDownloads, showLinkHoverURL

Missing fileExplorer.doubleClickAction preview|defaultEditor|preferredEditor and diffViewer.defaultLayout unified|split
